description.value: Nuba is a beloved Vancouver Lebanese restaurant group; the Kitsilano outpost is styled as a Lebanese taverna, with a cavernous multi-level interior of low-ceilinged nooks and a glass-covered courtyard filled with plants. Founded nearly 20 years ago, Nuba sources fresh, local, and organic ingredients daily and has long been regarded as one of Vancouver's go-to spots for feel-good, health-conscious Lebanese cooking. The menu is substantially vegan-friendly, with all meats halal and hormone-free, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists with diverse dietary needs.
